Subject: Due diligence packet + PO routing for Pinebrook Analytics

Hi Elena —

Great to connect yesterday. To get Pinebrook set up in our vendor/PO system and keep the integration timeline intact, procurement has asked for a short set of items we mandate for commercial vendors that touch production data:

1) Executed DPA (signed PDF)
2) Link to latest SOC 2 Type II report (or assessor portal link)
3) Complete subprocessor list with roles and hosting regions
4) W-9 or local equivalent for billing (if US entity)
5) Primary billing contact + remit-to email

I attached our Vendor_Onboarding_Form.docx to make the PO/invoice mapping easier — if you can fill the billing block and return, procurement can create the PO in 48 hours.

Target go-live: June 14th. If any of the security items require an NDA or separate request, let me know and I can loop legal.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Diego Fernández
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
